title: Law student moves Rajasthan High Court alleging inaction by college on his complaint
description: The Rajasthan High Court recently issued notice on a plea by a student of SS Jain Subodh Law College alleging inaction on his complaint against a college official.Justice Shubha Mehta of the Jaipur Bench issued notice on the plea on July 3.
